// "DM name collected" — a flat, month-agnostic tag per rep ("dm name
// collected-felix", "dm name collected-alvi", ...) marking that the rep
// captured the decision-maker's name for a contact. It carries no month
// component, so it's fetched once per rep here and applied as a boolean onto
// whatever ghl_outcomes row(s) that contact already gets from the mon-yy-rep
// loop below — it's a milestone on a contact already in the tracked funnel,
// not a new way into it. A rep with no such tag yet in GHL just gets an
// empty set back, so this is safe to leave running for all three reps even
// before jack's tag (if any) exists.
const dmCollectedIds = {};
for (const rep of REPS) {
  const dmTag = `dm name collected-${rep}`;
  const dmRes = await this.helpers.httpRequest({
    method: 'POST',
    url: 'https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/search',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${GHL_KEY}`,
      Version: '2021-07-28',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: {
      locationId: LOCATION_ID,
      pageLimit: 100,
      filters: [{ field: 'tags', operator: 'contains', value: dmTag }],
    },
    json: true,
  });
  dmCollectedIds[rep] = new Set((dmRes.contacts || []).map((c) => c.id));
}

const byKey = new Map(); // dedupe (contact, opportunity, rep) — keep the latest tag_month

for (const rep of REPS) {
  for (const mon of MONTHS) {
    const tag = `${mon}-${YEAR_2DIGIT}-${rep}`;
    const monthNum = String(MONTHS.indexOf(mon) + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const tagMonth = `20${YEAR_2DIGIT}-${monthNum}-01`;

    const res = await this.helpers.httpRequest({
      method: 'POST',
      url: 'https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/search',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${GHL_KEY}`,
        Version: '2021-07-28',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: {
        locationId: LOCATION_ID,
        pageLimit: 100,
        filters: [{ field: 'tags', operator: 'contains', value: tag }],
      },
      json: true,
    });

    for (const contact of res.contacts || []) {
      const opps = contact.opportunities || [];

      if (opps.length === 0) {
        // Tagged, but no opportunity was ever created for them — still a
        // real lead sitting at "New". Give it a stable synthetic id, scoped
        // to this rep, so a contact tagged to two reps at once (found live:
        // one contact carries both aug-26-alvi and aug-26-felix) gets one
        // row per rep instead of the second tag's write clobbering the first.
        const key = `${contact.id}::no-opp::${rep}`;
        const existing = byKey.get(key);
        if (existing && existing.tag_month >= tagMonth) continue;
        byKey.set(key, {
          contact_id: contact.id,
          opportunity_id: `${contact.id}::no-opp::${rep}`,
          phone: contact.phone || null,
          rep,
          tag,
          tag_month: tagMonth,
          stage_id: null,
          stage_bucket: 'new',
          opportunity_status: null,
          dm_collected: dmCollectedIds[rep].has(contact.id),
          synced_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        continue;
      }

      for (const o of opps) {
        const key = `${contact.id}::${o.id}::${rep}`;
        const existing = byKey.get(key);
        if (existing && existing.tag_month >= tagMonth) continue;
        byKey.set(key, {
          contact_id: contact.id,
          opportunity_id: o.id,
          phone: contact.phone || null,
          rep,
          tag,
          tag_month: tagMonth,
          stage_id: o.pipelineStageId,
          stage_bucket: STAGE_BUCKET[o.pipelineStageId] || 'unmapped',
          opportunity_status: o.status,
          dm_collected: dmCollectedIds[rep].has(contact.id),
          synced_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
      }
    }
  }
}

// Final safety net: the DB's unique key is (contact_id, opportunity_id) —
// it does NOT include rep. A contact tagged to two reps at once normally
// gets distinct synthetic ids (handled above), but if that ever happens to
// a contact that DOES have a real opportunity, two rows here would share
// the same real opportunity_id and the upsert below would fail outright for
// the whole batch. Collapse any such collision to one row per
// (contact_id, opportunity_id) so the sync can never break — this can only
// under-attribute one rare, already-flagged edge case, never crash the run.
const sendMap = new Map();
for (const row of byKey.values()) {
  const sendKey = `${row.contact_id}::${row.opportunity_id}`;
  sendMap.set(sendKey, row); // last write wins; rare enough not to need bucket-rank tiebreaking here
}

return [{ json: { rows: Array.from(sendMap.values()) } }];
